expectedRealization.rationale: Record auto-demand collapse should affect OEM earnings over the next reporting cycles; this is primarily an avoidance test.

changeHypothesis.summary: February auto sales collapsed about 79% YoY. Relative-price resilience during a broader market crash is not a positive earnings bridge.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Demand can rebound as restrictions ease, but the cutoff contains no verified recovery volume.
disconfirmingEvidence: The frozen auto basket was benchmark-relative favorable despite physical demand collapse, demonstrating why price relative strength alone can mislead.

causalChain.mechanism: Vehicle volumes fall sharply before fixed costs adjust.
causalChain.failureMode: a rapid V-shaped rebound arrives before earnings damage persists

falseThemeMatches: relative-strength OEMs without verified demand recovery
